_readme: The mods GML Manager offers in its Browse tab. To list your mod, open a pull request adding an entry. Each mod needs a public GitHub repo whose releases carry a zip laid out like Binaries\Win64 (GML\plugins\<Name>\...). guid must match the GML_PLUGIN guid in the DLL; asset is a wildcard for the release zip's name.

mods.name: Noveske Chainsaw
mods.author: RemArrow
mods.description: Adds a Noveske Chainsaw rifle to the gun spawner, with its own mesh, moving parts and PMAG. Nothing in the game is replaced.
mods.credits: Model and textures by 3DMA - 3D Military Assets, used under license

mods.name: Malfunctions
mods.author: RemArrow
mods.description: Every gun jams as often as its real counterpart: duds, failures to feed, stovepipes and double feeds, each cleared by hand. The P320 is not drop safe.

mods.name: MP7 40-Round Magazine
mods.author: RemArrow
mods.description: Every MP7 magazine holds 40 rounds and looks like the 40-rounder.
mods.credits: Magazine model by Alpooo (CGTrader, Royalty Free License)

mods.name: FPV Drone
mods.author: RemArrow
mods.description: An FPV kamikaze drone flown through DJI Goggles 2: acro flight model, Betaflight-style OSD and a grenade payload. Goggles in the Night Vision gear, drone in the explosives pouches; hold the right stick in to fly.
mods.credits: Models and textures by 3DMA - 3D Military Assets, used under license

mods.name: Gunsmith
mods.author: RemArrow
mods.description: Every attachment in the gun station changes how the gun handles: weight and balance, recoil, suppressor loudness, muzzle velocity, accuracy and scope glint.

mods.name: ECOTI Thermal Fusion
mods.author: RemArrow
mods.description: GPNVG-18 and PVS-31 with an ECOTI thermal clip-on in every phosphor, and a panoramic fusion goggle with an ATAK-style HUD: compass, team markers, waypoints.

mods.name: Custom Camo
mods.author: RemArrow
mods.description: One more camo, Custom Camo, at the end of the colour menu of every kit item that takes camo.

mods.name: Hand Poser
mods.author: RemArrow
mods.description: Make your own magazine hand poses: a web page (127.0.0.1:8765) sets where the hand sits and how every finger bends, live, while you hold the magazine.
